method: Four production cases naturally launch to 100 km/h: half steering/full throttle and full steering/lift at 2.0s/reapply at 2.7s, at L0 and L3. Same 0.5..4.5s steering interval and 9s recovery measurement as the main matrix. Fixed-step real RCCP raw input path; no velocity/pose writes. Production traction owns torque intervention.
acceptance: Production: body slip <20 degrees, all four wheels grounded, requested-direction heading at steering release >20 degrees, >60m travel and forward progress, final speed >30 km/h, raw throttle follows the requested input. At the end, torque scale >=95%, body slip <3 degrees, yaw <5 deg/s, and these conditions hold for the final continuous 0.3 seconds. Engine maximum torque must remain within 0.01 Nm of its authored value. Stock matrix 0-100 launch must remain within baseline*1.10+0.15s. Baseline spin is diagnostic only.
